card.name: Punctuation after dateline dates and dictionary dots
card.fires_on: The opening bracket right after a news-wire dateline (city, month and day) before an agency name, the dot inside dictionary syllable breaks, and the digit after the point in section numbers like 7.4.

modes.label: Wire dateline bracket
modes.description: The "(" after a city and date, just before an agency name such as ANI or IANS.

modes.label: Syllable dot in dictionary entries
modes.description: The middle dot that splits a headword into syllables.

modes.label: Section number digit
modes.description: The digit after the point in a numbered section heading.
modes.example: 7.<<4>> Vaccination During and for up to one
